mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.15% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.15%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 10.0% signals severe labor market distress, triggering immediate equity sell-offs due to recession fears and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 10.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a collapse in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recessionary pressures intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index during the post-recession recovery phase signals improving manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods classified as 'post-recession recovery'.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls indicates strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index below 90 indicates severe manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 90.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of near-zero interest rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.15%), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in prolonged monetary support and low discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.15%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and real GDP indicate a broad economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession fears dominate market sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline.
